metadata.name: pred_provable
metadata.description: Provable KPI Markets: outcome-token markets resolved by on-chain account reads

instructions.name: add_liquidity
docs: Deposit YES and NO into the guarded pool for LP shares. The first deposit sets the price.

accounts.name: lp_mint
docs: Pool shares. Created with the pool by its first provider.

instructions.name: burn_pair
docs: Anyone: burn equal YES and NO for their USDC back, 1:1, until resolution.

instructions.name: buy_yes
docs: Buy YES at the sponsor's fixed price before the cutoff and before the metric is met.
The matching NO is booked to the sponsor in `Market::sponsor_no`.

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Sponsor opens a market, creates its YES/NO mints and USDC vault, and deposits the bounty budget.

accounts.name: yes_mint
docs: Only the market can mint, and there is no freeze authority, so nobody can stop
holders from trading or redeeming.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Holds the budget and all collateral. Only the market can move it.

instructions.name: mint_pair
docs: Anyone: deposit USDC for the same number of YES and NO tokens, 1:1, until resolution.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Burn winning outcome tokens for USDC, 1:1.

accounts.name: winning_mint
docs: Checked against the outcome in the handler, so an open market reports `NotResolved`.

instructions.name: remove_liquidity
docs: Burn LP shares for a pro-rata cut of both reserves. Always open.

instructions.name: resolve
docs: Permissionless, instant resolution by reading the locked metric account.

instructions.name: swap
docs: Swap YES for NO or NO for YES on the pool; halts when the outcome becomes knowable.

instructions.name: withdraw_budget
docs: Sponsor takes back the budget no sale used once the sale is closed (or before any
sale), and its NO collateral 1:1 once NO wins.

errors.name: StakeTooSmall

errors.name: MintAuthorityLive

errors.name: AlreadyImmutable

errors.name: InvalidEpoch

fields.name: yes_price_bps
docs: What a buyer pays per YES, in basis points of its payout.

fields.name: sponsor_budget
docs: USDC the sponsor commits to cover the rest of each YES sold: the bounty.

types.name: Market
docs: KPI market with outcome tokens. The sponsor funds a budget and sells YES at a fixed
price. Each sale mints one YES to the buyer and books the matching NO to the sponsor
in `sponsor_no`. The buyer pays the price and the budget covers the rest, so every
YES is backed by exactly one USDC base unit held in the market's vault. The winning
side redeems 1:1 for it.
Invariants while the market is open:
`yes_supply == no_supply + sponsor_no` and `vault == budget + yes_supply`.

fields.name: target_pubkey
docs: Human-facing subject: mint, program id, or vote account.

fields.name: metric_account
docs: Account actually read at resolution (equals `target_pubkey`, except for
`Immutable`, where it is the derived ProgramData address, and `LockedAtLeast`,
where it is the incinerator's associated token account). Locked at creation.

fields.name: cutoff_slot
docs: Last slot (exclusive) in which YES can be bought.

fields.name: deadline_slot
docs: Last slot (inclusive) in which a ratchet metric may resolve YES.

fields.name: vault
docs: USDC token account owned by this market. Holds the unspent budget plus one base unit
per YES/NO pair.

fields.name: yes_price_bps
docs: What a buyer pays per YES, in basis points of its payout. The sponsor's
bounty per YES is the remaining `BPS_DENOMINATOR - yes_price_bps`.

fields.name: budget
docs: Sponsor USDC still available to cover future sales. Withdrawable after the sale closes.

fields.name: sponsor_no
docs: NO owed to the sponsor for every YES the sale minted. Kept as a balance instead of
tokens so the sponsor cannot burn it against YES to unwind the sale while it is open,
and the sale never depends on a token account the sponsor controls. Paid out by
`withdraw_budget` if NO wins.

fields.name: pool_yes
docs: Reserves of the guarded YES/NO pool. Tracked here instead of read from the pool's token
accounts, so tokens sent to the pool by hand cannot move its price.

types.name: ResolverKind
docs: Closed set of resolvers. Each variant fixes the owner and layout of the account
it reads; there is deliberately no generic "offset + comparator" reader.
Every variant reads state that flash capital cannot move: burned supply of a
mint with no authority, a revoked authority, tokens locked under the
incinerator, or stake frozen at the epoch boundary.

fields.name: budget
docs: Unspent budget paid out.

fields.name: sponsor_no
docs: The sponsor's NO paid out, 1:1, because NO won.

types.name: Swapped
docs: Reserves are after the swap, so the YES price is `pool_no / (pool_yes + pool_no)`.

fields.name: price
docs: USDC the buyer paid; the budget covered `amount - price`.

constants.name: BPS_DENOMINATOR
docs: YES price is quoted in basis points of the token's payout.

constants.name: MIN_STAKE
docs: Smallest sponsor budget, YES purchase, pair mint and first pool deposit: 1 USDC. Keeps dust out.

constants.name: OUTCOME_DECIMALS
docs: Outcome tokens use USDC's decimals, so one base unit redeems for exactly one USDC base unit.

constants.name: SWAP_FEE_BPS
docs: Pool swap fee, kept in the pool for liquidity providers.

constants.name: USDC_MINT
docs: Collateral for every market. Circle's devnet USDC by default; build with
`--features mainnet` for mainnet USDC.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: The market's USDC vault: a token account owned by the market PDA at a program-derived
address, so nobody else can create it first and block `create_market`.
